summary: Learn to build auditable AI-assisted financial models in Excel and Python. Develop scenarios, controls, and governance evidence. Enquire today.
lede: AI-assisted financial modelling helps finance and risk professionals build forecasts and scenarios with traceable assumptions. Participants use Excel and Python to govern data lineage, engineer and record prompts, test AI-generated formulas and code, and analyze sensitivities. They also practice model validation, documenting limitations and findings, and preparing governance materials for review.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for finance and risk professionals who need to use generative AI in financial modelling while maintaining traceability, validation discipline, and governance evidence.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of financial statements, budgeting or forecasting, and basic spreadsheet modelling is recommended. Familiarity with risk registers or model review processes helps, but advanced programming is not required. No coding or production model deployment is required for completion. Python content focuses on guided notebooks and operational application rather than technical engineering. Bring a laptop with Excel and a standard Python environment if available.
